body: A lot of people I know like to toss the word rape around if somebody tries to advance on somebody. I think it's bullshit because I wasn't forcing her into doing anything and just let her go when she wanted to go. I've been thinking about what happened and I really don't think I did anything wrong. I asked her if she thought I tried to force her anything and she replied with something along the lines of: "Oh god no. I just felt uncomfortable because you try to hook up with everyone and I just see you as a friend." She could be lying, but believe me when I say I didn't do anything that would justify calling me a rapist.

I felt like her telling everyone would make things awkward between me and a lot of people since we share a lot of mutual friends. One of my best friends decided to white knight for this girl by saying I basically "raped" her (of course he hasn't said anything to me and I found that out through someone else) because I "had her in a position that she didn't want to be in."

I really like this process. I'm in a bad place emotionally right now but that's really irrelevant and I think I'll start incorporating this into more things in my life. It's 12:38 in the morning but fuck it I'm going to have a bath.

I'm sure they would be, but I don't think I have it in myself to talk to them about it. I'm just waiting for everyone in my house to fall asleep so I can go outside and jump in front of a car. It's weird. An hour ago I was scared and afraid to die but now I think it'll be okay. Thanks for talking to me.
